notes.title: New Characters!
notes.content:
Greetings. We've been hard at work on a new update and are thrilled to introduce some exciting additions to the game.

Introducing METSURI - The New Hound Robot

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/4916723e7c90046850943d13b240486daae582a8.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/cab9aaf9f59e26946d2261926cc0117522127dda.jpg

We're excited to unveil our second Hound robot: METSURI! This new hunter changes the game's dynamic, especially when it comes to outdoor environments.

METSURI's Key Features:

Equipped with a chainsaw
Thermal vision capability
Higher running speed than humans
More sluggish turning and sprint start due to higher weight


METSURI is designed to be a formidable opponent in outdoor areas, particularly countering the strong hiding spots provided by bushes. However, its sluggish movements make narrow corridors your best escape route!

New Survivors

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/4a28acd6e8fefe0cea4d33ee4006b44c8c210bfc.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/06f9c7065810d465f06cd706f48aecfc5a7b42fb.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/178b65df406e30f8510cc30dc4d16e576732df28.png

In addition to METSURI, we're introducing three new survivors for you to unlock through gameplay. These new characters add more variety and strategy options to your survival attempts.

We're excited to see how these new additions will shake up the game and can't wait to hear your feedback. Happy hunting (or surviving)!

notes.title: 2 New Maps
notes.content:
It has been almost two weeks since HOUND: AUTOMATON launched. As the initial buzz fades, we're excited to revitalize the game with a new update featuring two new maps and interactive objects. We've also tweaked the nighttime lighting to enhance the gameplay experience. Let's dive into the major changes:

New Maps

Office
This fully interior map offers sneaky hiding spots throughout, designed to run smoothly on lower-end systems. The Office features numerous doors that can be opened to play mind games with the Hound.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/a1ba9e4ceb19a16b0f3f601e44ed4450ce7bcdf1.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/270e21378f97c7715d1f8c5df2ef534dd757d544.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/93b8fea0ed83fba2582fbd8bb0f994681a7f1853.jpg

Dockyard
We aimed to capture the warehouse map's style and character with this new addition. The Dockyard boasts many buildings to climb and hide in, surrounded by a forest that provides excellent escape routes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/9a27e6254c43cc7156d4dc614a23a76da9b7f875.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/7ce0e8a14c80c5d83644c46af8b512b5be4bcd0b.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/db936e2c427341e78a5a5d8cae12e61e87f15bc6.jpg

Moonlight Update
We've brightened the night to create a more moody atmosphere. While shadows and dark spots can still be used as hiding spots, the improved visibility enhances overall gameplay. Night and day experiences remain distinct, offering varied strategies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/2d501544e7a097007ff5b80c7574dcb9d61ca6cc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/985ef54e383e9b952ba9b6c5d51fe1cc983318d7.png

Interactable Objects
The new maps and the factory now feature doors and other interactive objects that you can use with [Q] as the default binding. We've also added functioning elevators to some maps.

[previewyoutube=ec2aCaO_Dgg;full]Doors[/previewyoutube]

We believe these updates will add depth to the gameplay and provide fresh experiences for all players. Thank you for your continued support, and happy hunting!

notes.title: Bug Fixes, CPU Optimization & In-Game Chat
notes.content:
We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has purchased and supported our game. Seeing so many players enjoying the experience we've created is incredibly exciting. Your enthusiasm drives us to keep improving and expanding the game.

We're excited to bring you our latest update, which includes several improvements and fixes:

New Feature

 In-game chat: Press Enter to open the chat window and communicate with other players while hiding in a bush.

Performance Improvements

 CPU optimization: Animations are now less CPU-intensive when other players are out of sight.
 Reduced foliage: Bushes and small trees have been reduced by 20% to help find players in the forests.

Balance Changes

 Human speed adjustment: Humans are now as fast as robots when uninjured, and 5% slower than robots when injured.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a climbing exploit in Cemetery tunnels.
 Resolved an issue where matches would start without any hunters.
 Fixed missing level boundaries in the Snow Village map.

Coming Soon

We're thrilled to announce that we're working on a new map! Stay tuned for more information about this exciting addition to the game, which will be released soon.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE: OCT. 21 2024
notes.content:
Greetings,

Over 1,000 testers logged in and tried the game during our playtest week, and we're thrilled with how players received it and the fun they had. We've been working nonstop, and we're excited to announce that we're ready to launch on October 21st—just 10 days away! So get ready, load up your shotgun and movement sensors, and join us for the hunt. Now, let's dive into the playtest results.

Playtest Feedback

We're delighted that most players enjoyed the simple yet engaging hide-and-seek gameplay. We also received numerous ideas to add more variety in actions and game modes. We'll introduce some of these as customizable settings for sessions, while others will be implemented as separate modes after launch. The playtest also helped us uncover many bugs that our internal testing missed, making it a resounding success. We've already fixed all the issues found during the playtest.

We've added several quality-of-life features you requested, including lobby-ready indicators, player muting options, in-game server setting adjustments, voting for the next map, and more interesting ways to score and become the best hider in your lobby.

We've also improved the process of finding games when there are no active lobbies or games currently running.

Content on Release

Our original concept was simple, and we wanted to maintain that essence. We've mainly focused on adding more survivor and hunter characters for you to play as, along with more maps. The game will launch with four maps, each offering substantial replayability and unique settings. We're confident you'll enjoy many sessions with your friends, and we're excited to hear about your favorites when the game launches!

We will be introducing more characters and maps in future updates, alongside new modes and hunters. Our commitment to expanding the game doesn't end at launch – we have exciting plans to keep the content fresh and engaging for our players.

Map Showcase: Cemetery

Those of you who participated in the playtest have already experienced this map, but we wanted to share pictures with everyone to showcase what we've been working on. This map has a very different layout compared to the warehouse, featuring paths that lead to graveyards and a large church visible from all areas of the map. The church serves as a monument for orientation. Behind the church, there's a pathway to an underground crypt that could be either your best hiding spot or your final resting place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/6a3b0ff0ecb1831243ad5a45d262b8f0201ff0a7.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/24b56d41cf90ee28f2f0d31db9edfec366f7d424.jpg

We can't wait for you to experience the full game on October 21st. Get ready for the hunt!

notes.title: Join the Hunt!
notes.content:
Join the Hunt!

The time has finally arrived for you all to join the Hunt for a limited-time testing period. We're excited to have you experience our game and provide valuable feedback!

What's in the Game?


Game Mode: Hide and seek
Maps: 2 playable maps
Hosting: Easy server configuration with multiple settings
Multiplayer: Join public lobbies or play with friends via Steam
Survivor Mechanic: Delay capture by pushing the robot, gaining precious seconds to escape
Hunter Gadget: New throwable device that provides audio cues for nearby Humans, with intensity varying based on proximity


Issue Reporting

Please remember that this is an early build, and bugs are expected. We value your input in identifying and resolving these issues. You can report problems through the in-game menu or the main menu using the provided form. We'll begin addressing these issues next week.

Known Issues:


Push To Talk is currently non-functional
Crouching as Hunter causes gun visibility and aiming issues
Joining mid-game may result in temporary desync before connection stabilizes
Background music is not yet implemented


Join Our Community!

We're eager to hear your thoughts on the game. Join our Discord server to share your feedback, ask questions, and connect with other players and developers.

Thank you for participating in our playtest. Your input is crucial in shaping the future of our game. Happy hunting!

Join our Discord

notes.title: Playtest: September 27th - October 7th
notes.content:
Greetings,

We're thrilled to announce that we're now accepting playtest access requests to help us improve our game and identify any issues we might have missed.

To join the playtest, visit our game's Steam page and look for the "Request Access" button under the "Add to Wishlist" button. Click it to join the waitlist and get notified when you can download and play the game.

Important Dates:

Playtest Start: Friday, September 27th
Playtest End: Monday, October 7th

We encourage you to join our Discord server, where we'll actively answer questions and discuss the game. It's the perfect place to share your thoughts and experiences during the playtest.

notes.title: DEVLOG 1
notes.content:
Greetings,

This is our first devlog of a new photorealistic hide-and-seek party game. We've been working hard on adding mechanics and release content to the game and we'd like to keep you updated as often as we can. For more frequent updates on all things big and small, follow us on our Discord.

Playtests Coming Soon

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/58148432e13317559225a8d0acdc332e1e6fff20.png

We're gearing up for our first round of playtests, and we're excited to have the community join in! If you want to be part of the early gameplay experience, make sure to join our Discord Server. We'll be announcing the details there soon, and spots are limited, so don’t miss out!

Push Mechanic

We've added a new push mechanic for runners! If a runner gets up close and personal with the automaton, they can deliver a well-timed push to knock it down, giving them a few precious moments to escape. Of course, the automaton won’t stay down for long, so use it wisely! Check out the mechanic in action:

[previewyoutube=pngTDcDXpUw;full][/previewyoutube]

Scoring System Added

We've added a new scoring system to track your performance. Here's how it works:

Whistling in the game will reveal your location to hunters, but it's not without reward. Each whistle grants you extra points. It's a risk-reward mechanic that adds an exciting layer of strategy to the game.

Surviving a round and escaping close encounters with hunters will also earn you points. The more dangerous the situation you escape from, the more points you'll receive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45173113/c827d2fbea232e40250b1299cdb37cd310417f40.jpg

Map Showcase: Warehouse

Lastly, we’re thrilled to show off our first map: the Warehouse. This semi-open level with both outdoors and indoors hiding locations is perfect for nerve-wracking hide-and-seek chases. Filled with towering shelves, narrow corridors, and unexpected hiding spots, it's the ultimate battleground for runners trying to outwit the hunter. Of course, this is still work-in-progress and subject to change, but here's how it stands today.

Check out these screenshots from the Warehouse map:
